The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.

The provided text aligns strongly with the post-apocalyptic and dystopian subgenres of science fiction and speculative fiction. The setting of a "barren wasteland" and a "former metropolis" reduced to ruins is a hallmark of post-apocalyptic narratives, which often explore the collapse of civilization. The presence of "warlords" and "scavenger gangs" reflects common tropes regarding the breakdown of social order and the rise of new, often brutal, power structures in lawless environments. Furthermore, the protagonist's journey to find an "oasis" represents the classic quest motif, emphasizing themes of survival, human tenacity, and the enduring hope for renewal amidst desolation. These elements collectively situate the text firmly within the conventions of the genre, focusing on resilience and the search for safety in a hostile world.
